t: Jacob Two-Two: Jacob Two-Two and the Fantastic Fountain
st: Jacob Two-Two and the Fantastic Fountain
d: Jacob is concerned about his Zadie Saul's aches and pains.

t: Jacob Two-Two: Jacob Two-Two and the Spellbound Sibling
st: Jacob Two-Two and the Spellbound Sibling
d: Jacob's wish he could find a way to make big sister Marfa be nicer to him.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: School Trip To... Aquaworld!
d: Beanie brings Admiral Bubbles on a school trip to Aqua World, hoping his goldfish will learn proper behavior from the other fish. Instead, Admiral Bubbles is outraged at this public display of enslavement.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: Space Command, We Have A Goldfish!
st: Space Command, We Have A Goldfish!
d: Thanks to a little trickery on the part of Admiral Bubbles, Beanie wins the school science fair.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: Show & Tell
d: For show and tell at school, Beanie brings "the foulest, most monstrous creature alive!" to show his classmates: Admiral Bubbles!

t: Class of the Titans: Cronus 2.0
d: With Hephaestus' help, Odie creates an android to simulate Cronus' moves, one that can learn to adapt, in order to test their skills

t: Class of the Titans: The Game Pan
d: Cronus poses as Amaltheia, the goat who raised his son Zeus, and whisks Zeus off for a fatal game of battle chess

t: Class of the Titans: Like a Rolling Stone
d: Cronus strikes a deal with the crafty Sisyphus' freedom from his eternal punishment, in exchange for the life of one of the heroes

t: Class of the Titans: Cronus' Keystroke
d: Cronus gets his hands on Theresa's pendant.  He convinces the magical Telkhines to unlock its secret by giving them their enemy, Poseidon

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: Too Cool for School
d: Junior High School friends Stephanie and Jan hate rules.

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: Waste Not, Haunt Not
d: Richard and his younger brother Stephen, are willing to try anything to design the winning Science Fair project.

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: Trouble in Store
d: Best friends Derek and Rob love new things.

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: All Booked Up
d: Thirteen year old Greg Davis hates books.

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: Jet is wake-boarding across Lake Megalopolis when he does an aerial move, and tries to land… only to crash into a dry lake bed. All of the lake’s water has suddenly vanished, leaving behind only fish and the speedboat Chow was using to tow Jet.

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: After a high-speed chase for a crystal, Skor’s run ends in a Chow-style roadbock: AKA a gaint pile of manure. Skor vows to “erase them from history! ” and he isn’t kidding.

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: Edgar excitedly shows the posse his new telescope. He plans to use it to watch “Bailey’s Comet. ”  It’s a brilliant comet streaking through the sky – making its closest pass to earth in nearly 60 million years.

t: Sabrina The Animated Series: I Got Glue Babe
d: Everyone is fed up with Sabrina and Gem's constant rivalry. Sabrina casts a spell to make Gem and herself closer. But she uses too much potion and it causes them to stick together.

t: Sabrina The Animated Series: Boy Meets Bike
d: Sabrina makes a dreambike for Harvey, so he can beat the bully Slugloaf. Unfortunately the bike, Sheba, takes on a life of it's own with the intention of Winning no matter what.

t: Sabrina's Secret Life: Hot Item
d: While shopping with Sabrina, Maritza ogles a necklace that Cassandra buys. Knowing how much Maritza wants it, the unkind young witch uses it to taunt Maritza.

t: Sabrina's Secret Life: What’s In A Name?
d: Sabrina and Cassandra bicker their way through another potion-making assignment at the witches’ academy. Their arguing causes them to spill the entire vial of Salvia Muscaria: an extremely rare herb!

t: A Second Chance
d: A young girl and her coach overcome adversity to make their way into the National Australian Gymnastics Squad.

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: So Very Attractive
d: Fourteen year old Julia is obsessed with being beautiful.

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: Drawn and Quartered
d: Aspiring artist Ralph Philips is focused on perfecting his art.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: The Ice-Roaches Cometh!
d: Mom uncovers a cockroach and runs away to phone for pest control help. Beanie investigates and soon uncovers his goldfish's plan: to send fiery cockroaches to the North Pole, where they will quickly multiply and melt the Polar Ice Caps.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: Sewer Adventure!
d: Admiral Bubbles tricks Mom into believing she accidentally killed him. Horrified, she flushes him down the toilet, then quickly buys an identical fish to replace him with, hoping Beanie won't notice.

t: Class of the Titans: Daedalus or Alive
d: Hoping to find some lost papers or inventions left behind by Daedalus, Odie discovers Daedalus is still alive!

t: Class of the Titans: Face Off
d: Neil is no longer the fairest of them all when Adonis appears

t: The Triplets: Hansel and Gretel
d: Hansel, Gretel, and the Triplets can't resist entering a village made entirely of candy. It doesn't take them long to realize that this place is a trick, but it's too late.

t: The Triplets: The Emperor's New Clothes
d: The emperor hires the Triplets to design him a new suit. When the suit is ready, the Bored Witch makes it disappear.

t: Pippi Longstocking: Pippi Doesn't Go To School
d: Pippi discovers that she is missing out on certain holidays because she doesn't go to school, so there is nothing to take a holiday from.

t: Pippi Longstocking: Pippi Goes Up North
d: Pippi and her friends join Captain Longstocking on a journey to a remote Northern Community to deliver supplies.  It is a trip full of adventure as they team up with the natives to battle storms, icebergs and "poachers."

t: Pippi Longstocking: Pippi Saves the Whales - Again
d: The field trip up North continues and Pippi and her "crew" must outsmart Poachers to save the rare green whales from extinction.

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: Skor plans to flatten Megalopolis with a massive, 60-story tall rock, but he suddenly has no one to help him push the rock down his mountain. His normally-subservient army of Links has run off in disgust over being fed the wrong meal at lunchtime.

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: After playing the “home version” of one of his favorite competitive eating shows, Chow receives a phone call naming him winner of a cruise for him and all his friends. Edgar will be staying home.

t: Massive Monster Mayhem
d: All of Master Mayhem’s monsters have gone on strike! They won’t conquer any more planets until he pays them more Space Bucks. Now MM’s got to convince the ancient rock goddess Eye Eye Eye to step in and step on all of us instead.
